description: A simple clean follow-up: check whether smaller grids with repeated food trips make the full pheromone input reliably useful before Phase 2B.
selection_rule: No automatic winner. A candidate can move to team review only when full-input PPO beats its same-seed separately trained no-pheromone PPO and random action on all three declared seeds. This is still development work, not Phase 2B.
required_reports: per-seed stochastic and deterministic food-delivery means
random-action reference on the same diagnostic maps
training/runtime provenance and every failed run
